    a.sort()

def min_additional_problems(n, m, a, b):
    a.sort()
    b.sort()
    
    additional_problems = 0
    j = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        while j < m and b[j] < a[i]:
            j += 1
        if j == m:
            additional_problems += 1
        else:
            j += 1
    
    return additional_problems
